name: Gas Sensor Array Drift Dataset
description: The Gas Sensor Array Drift dataset is a benchmark time-series and tabular sensor dataset collected by the BioCircuits Institute at UC San Diego. Recorded over a 36-month period using an array of 16 metal-oxide semiconductor gas sensors, it contains 13,910 measurements across six chemical volatile organic compounds (ethanol, ethylene, carbon monoxide, methane, acetaldehyde, toluene) to evaluate concept drift compensation and robust sensor pattern classification.
